}{

{\ottdrulename{pathE2}}{}%
}}

%% defn WFdecl
\newcommand{\ottdruleWFdeclOne}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash   \epsilon  \, \ottkw{decl}}{%
{\ottdrulename{WFdecl1}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleWFdeclTwo}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{T} \, \ottkw{type}}%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \ottsym{;}  \ottkw{type} \, t_i  \ottsym{=}  \ottnt{T}  \vdash  \ottnt{D} \, \ottkw{decl}}%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottsym{(}  \ottkw{type} \, t_i  \ottsym{=}  \ottnt{T}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{D}  \ottsym{)} \, \ottkw{decl}}{%
{\ottdrulename{WFdecl2}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleWFdeclThree}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \ottsym{;}  \ottkw{type} \, t_i  \vdash  \ottnt{D} \, \ottkw{decl}}%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottsym{(}  \ottkw{type} \, t_i  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{D}  \ottsym{)} \, \ottkw{decl}}{%
{\ottdrulename{WFdecl3}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleWFdeclFour}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{S} \, \ottkw{signature}}%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \ottsym{;}  \ottkw{structure} \, x_i  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{S}  \vdash  \ottnt{D} \, \ottkw{decl}}%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottsym{(}  \ottkw{structure} \, x_i  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{S}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{D}  \ottsym{)} \, \ottkw{decl}}{%
{\ottdrulename{WFdecl4}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleWFdeclFive}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{T} \, \ottkw{type}}%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \ottsym{;}  \ottkw{val} \, v_i  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T}  \vdash  \ottnt{D} \, \ottkw{decl}}%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottsym{(}  \ottkw{val} \, v_i  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{D}  \ottsym{)} \, \ottkw{decl}}{%
{\ottdrulename{WFdecl5}}{}%
}}

\newcommand{\ottdefnWFdecl}[1]{\begin{ottdefnblock}[#1]{$\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{D} \, \ottkw{decl}$}{}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleWFdeclOne{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleWFdeclTwo{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleWFdeclThree{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleWFdeclFour{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleWFdeclFive{}}
\end{ottdefnblock}}

%% defn WFsig
\newcommand{\ottdruleWFsigOne}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{D} \, \ottkw{decl}}%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottsym{(}  \ottkw{sig} \, \ottnt{D} \, \ottkw{end}  \ottsym{)} \, \ottkw{signature}}{%
{\ottdrulename{WFsig1}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleWFsigTwo}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{S_{{\mathrm{1}}}} \, \ottkw{signature}}%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \ottsym{;}  \ottkw{structure} \, x_i  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{S_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \vdash  \ottnt{S_{{\mathrm{2}}}} \, \ottkw{signature}}%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottsym{(}  \ottkw{functor} \, \ottsym{(}  x_i  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{S_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{)}  \ottnt{S_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{)} \, \ottkw{signature}}{%
{\ottdrulename{WFsig2}}{}%
}}

\newcommand{\ottdefnWFsig}[1]{\begin{ottdefnblock}[#1]{$\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{S} \, \ottkw{signature}$}{}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleWFsigOne{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleWFsigTwo{}}
\end{ottdefnblock}}


\newcommand{\ottdefnsWFsig}{
\ottdefnWFdecl{}\ottdefnWFsig{}}

% defns eq
%% defn eqT
\newcommand{\ottdruleeqTOne}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
\ottnt{E_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{;}  \ottkw{type} \, t_i  \ottsym{=}  \ottnt{T}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{E_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \vdash  t_i  \approx  \ottnt{T}}{%
{\ottdrulename{eqT1}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleeqTTwo}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{p}  \mapsto  \ottkw{sig} \, \ottnt{D_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{;}  \ottkw{type} \,  \ottmv{t} _ \ottmv{i}   \ottsym{=}  \ottnt{T}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{D_{{\mathrm{2}}}} \, \ottkw{end}}%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{p}  \ottsym{.}  \ottmv{t}  \approx   \ottnt{T} \{n_i \leftarrow  \ottnt{p} .n | n_i \in BV( \ottnt{D_{{\mathrm{1}}}} )\} }{%
{\ottdrulename{eqT2}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleeqTThree}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{T}  \approx  \ottnt{T}}{%
{\ottdrulename{eqT3}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleeqTFour}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \approx  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}}%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \approx  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{eqT4}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleeqTFive}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \approx  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}}}%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \approx  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{3}}}}}%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \approx  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{3}}}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{eqT5}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleeqTSix}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \approx  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{3}}}}}%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \approx  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{4}}}}}%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottsym{(}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \rightarrow  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{)}  \approx  \ottsym{(}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{3}}}}  \rightarrow  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{4}}}}  \ottsym{)}}{%
{\ottdrulename{eqT6}}{}%
}}

\newcommand{\ottdefneqT}[1]{\begin{ottdefnblock}[#1]{$\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{T}  \approx  \ottnt{T'}$}{}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleeqTOne{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleeqTTwo{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleeqTThree{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleeqTFour{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleeqTFive{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleeqTSix{}}
\end{ottdefnblock}}


\newcommand{\ottdefnseq}{
\ottdefneqT{}}

% defns sub
%% defn subS
\newcommand{\ottdrulesubSOne}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{S_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{<:}  \ottnt{S_{{\mathrm{1}}}}}%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \ottsym{;}  \ottkw{structure} \, x_i  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{S_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \vdash  \ottnt{S'_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{<:}  \ottnt{S'_{{\mathrm{2}}}}}%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottkw{functor} \, \ottsym{(}  x_i  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{S_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{)}  \ottnt{S'_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{<:}  \ottkw{functor} \, \ottsym{(}  x_i  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{S_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{)}  \ottnt{S'_{{\mathrm{2}}}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{subS1}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdrulesubSTwo}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{D}  \ottsym{<:}  \ottnt{D'}}%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottkw{sig} \, \ottnt{D} \, \ottkw{end}  \ottsym{<:}  \ottkw{sig} \, \ottnt{D'} \, \ottkw{end}}{%
{\ottdrulename{subS2}}{}%
}}

\newcommand{\ottdefnsubS}[1]{\begin{ottdefnblock}[#1]{$\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{S}  \ottsym{<:}  \ottnt{S'}$}{}
\ottusedrule{\ottdrulesubSOne{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdrulesubSTwo{}}
\end{ottdefnblock}}

%% defn subD
\newcommand{\ottdrulesubDOne}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash   \epsilon   \ottsym{<:}   \epsilon }{%
{\ottdrulename{subD1}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdrulesubDTwo}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%

\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{C}  \vdash  \ottnt{D}  \ottsym{<:}  \ottnt{D'}}%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{C}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{D}  \ottsym{<:}  \ottnt{C'}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{D'}}{%
{\ottdrulename{subD2}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdrulesubDThree}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{C}  \vdash  \ottnt{D}  \ottsym{<:}  \ottnt{D'}}%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{C}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{D}  \ottsym{<:}  \ottnt{D'}}{%
{\ottdrulename{subD3}}{}%
}}

\newcommand{\ottdefnsubD}[1]{\begin{ottdefnblock}[#1]{$\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{D}  \ottsym{<:}  \ottnt{D'}$}{}

\ottusedrule{\ottdrulesubDTwo{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdrulesubDThree{}}

%% defn subC
\newcommand{\ottdrulesubCOne}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottsym{(}  \ottkw{type} \, t_i  \ottsym{)}  \ottsym{<:}  \ottsym{(}  \ottkw{type} \, t_i  \ottsym{)}}{%
{\ottdrulename{subC1}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdrulesubCTwo}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottsym{(}  \ottkw{type} \, t_i  \ottsym{=}  \ottnt{T}  \ottsym{)}  \ottsym{<:}  \ottsym{(}  \ottkw{type} \, t_i  \ottsym{)}}{%
{\ottdrulename{subC2}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdrulesubCFour}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \approx  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}}}%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottsym{(}  \ottkw{type} \, t_i  \ottsym{=}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{)}  \ottsym{<:}  \ottsym{(}  \ottkw{type} \, t_i  \ottsym{=}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{)}}{%
{\ottdrulename{subC4}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdrulesubCFive}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{S_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{<:}  \ottnt{S_{{\mathrm{2}}}}}%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottsym{(}  \ottkw{structure} \, x_i  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{S_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{)}  \ottsym{<:}  \ottsym{(}  \ottkw{structure} \, x_i  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{S_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{)}}{%
{\ottdrulename{subC5}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdrulesubCSix}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \approx  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}}}%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottsym{(}  \ottkw{val} \, v_i  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{)}  \ottsym{<:}  \ottsym{(}  \ottkw{val} \, v_i  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{)}}{%
{\ottdrulename{subC6}}{}%
}}

\newcommand{\ottdefnsubC}[1]{\begin{ottdefnblock}[#1]{$\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{C}  \ottsym{<:}  \ottnt{C'}$}{}

\end{ottdefnblock}}


\newcommand{\ottdefnssub}{

% defns typ
%% defn type_s
\newcommand{\ottdruletypeXXsOne}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{p}  \mapsto  \ottnt{S}}%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{p}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{S}}{%
{\ottdrulename{type\_s1}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruletypeXXsTwo}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{S} \, \ottkw{signature}}%
\ottpremise{ x_i \not\in BV( \ottnt{E} ) }%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \ottsym{;}  \ottkw{structure} \, x_i  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{S}  \vdash  \ottnt{s}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{S'}}%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottkw{functor} \, \ottsym{(}  x_i  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{S}  \ottsym{)}  \ottnt{s}  \ottsym{:}  \ottkw{functor} \, \ottsym{(}  x_i  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{S}  \ottsym{)}  \ottnt{S'}}{%
{\ottdrulename{type\_s2}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruletypeXXsThree}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{s}  \ottsym{:}  \ottkw{functor} \, \ottsym{(}  x_i  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{S'}  \ottsym{)}  \ottnt{S}}%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{p}  \mapsto  \ottnt{S''}}%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{S''}  \ottsym{<:}  \ottnt{S'}}%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{s}  \ottsym{(}  \ottnt{p}  \ottsym{)}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{S}  \ottsym{\{}  x_i  \leftarrow  \ottnt{p}  \ottsym{\}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{type\_s3}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruletypeXXsFour}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{d}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{D}}%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottkw{struct} \, \ottnt{d} \, \ottkw{end}  \ottsym{:}  \ottkw{sig} \, \ottnt{D} \, \ottkw{end}}{%
{\ottdrulename{type\_s4}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruletypeXXsFive}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{S_{{\mathrm{1}}}} \, \ottkw{signature}}%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{s}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{S_{{\mathrm{2}}}}}%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{S_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{<:}  \ottnt{S_{{\mathrm{1}}}}}%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{s}  \ottsym{:>}  \ottnt{S_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{S_{{\mathrm{1}}}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{type\_s5}}{}%
}}

\newcommand{\ottdefntypeXXs}[1]{\begin{ottdefnblock}[#1]{$\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{s}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{S}$}{}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruletypeXXsOne{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruletypeXXsTwo{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruletypeXXsThree{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruletypeXXsFour{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruletypeXXsFive{}}
\end{ottdefnblock}}

%% defn type_c
\newcommand{\ottdruletypeXXcOne}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{T} \, \ottkw{type}}%
\ottpremise{ t_i \not\in BV( \ottnt{E} ) }%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottkw{type} \, t_i  \ottsym{=}  \ottnt{T}  \ottsym{:}  \ottkw{type} \, t_i  \ottsym{=}  \ottnt{T}}{%
{\ottdrulename{type\_c1}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruletypeXXcTwo}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{ t_i \not\in BV( \ottnt{E} ) }%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottkw{datatype} \, t_i  \ottsym{:}  \ottkw{type} \, t_i}{%
{\ottdrulename{type\_c2}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruletypeXXcThree}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{s}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{S}}%
\ottpremise{ x_i \not\in BV( \ottnt{E} ) }%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottkw{structure} \, x_i  \ottsym{=}  \ottnt{s}  \ottsym{:}  \ottkw{structure} \, x_i  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{S}}{%
{\ottdrulename{type\_c3}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruletypeXXcFour}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{M}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T}}%
\ottpremise{ v_i \not\in BV( \ottnt{E} ) }%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottkw{val} \, v_i  \ottsym{=}  \ottnt{M}  \ottsym{:}  \ottkw{val} \, v_i  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T}}{%
{\ottdrulename{type\_c4}}{}%
}}

\newcommand{\ottdefntypeXXc}[1]{\begin{ottdefnblock}[#1]{$\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{c}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{C}$}{}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruletypeXXcOne{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruletypeXXcTwo{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruletypeXXcThree{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruletypeXXcFour{}}
\end{ottdefnblock}}

%% defn type_d
\newcommand{\ottdruletypeXXdOne}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash   \epsilon   \ottsym{:}   \epsilon }{%
{\ottdrulename{type\_d1}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruletypeXXdTwo}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{c}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{C}}%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{C}  \vdash  \ottnt{d}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{D}}%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{c}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{d}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{C}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{D}}{%
{\ottdrulename{type\_d2}}{}%
}}

\newcommand{\ottdefntypeXXd}[1]{\begin{ottdefnblock}[#1]{$\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{d}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{D}$}{}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruletypeXXdOne{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruletypeXXdTwo{}}
\end{ottdefnblock}}

%% defn typeM
\newcommand{\ottdruletypeMOne}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
\ottnt{E_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{;}  \ottkw{val} \, v_i  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{E_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \vdash  v_i  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T}}{%
{\ottdrulename{typeM1}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruletypeMTwo}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{p}  \mapsto  \ottkw{sig} \, \ottnt{D_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{;}  \ottkw{val} \,  \ottmv{v} _ \ottmv{i}   \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{D_{{\mathrm{2}}}} \, \ottkw{end}}%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{p}  \ottsym{.}  \ottmv{v}  \ottsym{:}   \ottnt{T} \{n_i \leftarrow  \ottnt{p} .n | n_i \in BV( \ottnt{D_{{\mathrm{1}}}} )\} }{%
{\ottdrulename{typeM2}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruletypeMThree}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{ v_i \not\in BV( \ottnt{E} ) }%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}} \, \ottkw{type}}%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \ottsym{;}  \ottkw{val} \, v_i  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \vdash  \ottnt{M}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}}}%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \lambda \, v_i  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{.}  \ottnt{M}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \rightarrow  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{typeM3}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruletypeMFour}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{M_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \rightarrow  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}}}%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{M_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}}%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{M_{{\mathrm{1}}}} \, \ottnt{M_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{typeM4}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruletypeMFive}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{d}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{D}}%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \ottsym{;} \, \ottkw{rev} \, \ottnt{D}  \vdash  \ottnt{M}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}}%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \ottsym{;} \, \ottkw{rev} \, \ottnt{D}  \vdash  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \approx  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}}}%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}} \, \ottkw{type}}%
}{
\ottnt{E}  \vdash  \ottkw{let} \, \ottnt{d} \, \ottkw{in} \, \ottnt{M}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{typeM5}}{}%
}}

\ottusedrule{\ottdruletypeMOne{}}

}}
